title: Cocktail: Chunk-Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Long-Context LLM Inference
problem: Long-context LLM inference suffers from intolerable latency and GPU memory consumption; token-level KV cache quantization is time-consuming in search and hardware-inefficient during computation.
motivation: Long-context LLMs require faster, memory-efficient inference while maintaining accuracy.
method: Cocktail performs chunk-level quantization search based on query-context similarity scores, reorders KV cache chunks before quantization to avoid hardware inefficiency from mixed-precision computation.
key_novelty: Chunk-level granularity with explicit reordering resolves hardware inefficiency in mixed-precision KV cache computation.
contributions: Chunk-level quantization search avoiding expensive token-level search
KV cache chunk reordering for hardware efficiency
Maintains model accuracy across various LLM scales
Outperforms SOTA KV cache quantization methods

metrics.area: reduced GPU memory for KV cache

limitations: Specific speedup and memory reduction percentages not provided in abstract.
primary_theme: chunk-adaptive KV cache quantization for long-context LLMs
